image_description: A colorful minibus (likely a converted van chassis) parked on a paved surface. The vehicle features a two-tone livery with a red roof and upper front, and lime green/yellow sides with maroon lower panels. It has a prominent black front grille, a large windshield with wipers, side mirrors, and visible wheels. Text is visible on the destination board above the windshield and on the license plate.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits the characteristic high-roof van/minibus silhouette, clearly distinct from a sedan or full-size transit bus.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield is clearly visible, and the side profile shows window structures consistent with a passenger cabin.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle height is appropriate for a minibus. While the specific door mechanism isn't fully open, the panel lines on the side indicate a sliding door location typical for this class.
Vertical seams and handle placements on the side correspond to a sliding passenger door configuration.
The short hood and grille placement indicate a front-engine layout typical of van-based minibuses.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is a front-three-quarter view; the rear of the vehicle is completely occluded and outside the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle displays a complex, multi-colored livery (red, green, maroon) which fits the 'company livery' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible front wheel is proportionate to the vehicle body and appears to be a standard steel rim with a hubcap.
The overall scale and window configuration are consistent with a vehicle designed for small group transport.

artifact_observations.location: Destination sign above windshield and license plate
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the destination blind ('...BUS...') and the license plate characters are distorted and illegible, resembling AI-generated pseudo-text rather than crisp alphanumeric characters.
The reflection in the side mirror is muddy and lacks clear definition. The windshield reflections appear slightly painted-on rather than optically accurate.
The mesh pattern of the grille becomes irregular and melts slightly into the surrounding bumper plastic, lacking the rigid geometric consistency of a real manufactured part.

alignment_reasoning: The image aligns exceptionally well with the 'minibus' class. All testable geometric and functional checkpoints are present. The vehicle proportions, livery, and component placement are highly accurate to the taxonomy definition. Only the rear view checkpoint was untestable due to camera angle.
artifact_reasoning: While structurally sound, the image exhibits moderate AI artifacts. The most significant issue is text gibberish on the signage and license plate (severity 2.5). Additionally, there are minor texture inconsistencies in reflections and slight structural softness in the grille details, preventing a perfect artifact score.
